title: Jet drones are Putin’s secret weapon as he seeks to break Ukraine
gist: Russia's monthly jet-drone launches against Ukraine roughly doubled from about 1500 in July 2026 to about 3200 in September, enabling round-the-clock strikes on Kyiv that evade existing air defenses. Ukraine's propeller-drone interceptors are now too slow, its F-16 fleet is strained, and the article argues only new jet interceptors, AI-guided turrets and long-range strikes on Russian production can blunt the threat before winter.

insights.claim: According to Ukrainian officials, Russia launched around 1500 jet drones at Ukraine in July 2026, about 2850 in August and approximately 3200 in September.
insights.speaker: Peter Dickinson
insights.so_what: A more-than-doubling in two months shows rapidly scaling Russian drone production and rising air-defense demand.
insights.quote: In July 2026, Russia launched around 1500 jet drones at targets across Ukraine. The following month, this figure rose to 2850. During September, approximately 3200 jet drones were deployed.

insights.claim: Unlike earlier overnight Russian bombardments, jet drone attacks on Kyiv run continuously through the day, preventing schools, businesses, shops, restaurants and public transport from operating.
